author: Rexzizz
quote: GTA 6 is a massive disappointment and completely overpriced. After more than 13 years, Rockstar, a multibillion-dollar company, delivered a buggy game that falls short in so many ways. They removed great features that made previous GTA games special, yet expect players to pay a premium price. With that much money, time, and resources, there's simply no excuse for such a disappointing experience. We deserved much better!
